name: How long does it take to install new door casing for an average home?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install new door casing for an average home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required for door casing installation varies depending on the number of doors and the complexity of each doorway. A skilled installer can often complete casing for several standard doors in a single day. However, older homes or those requiring custom cuts, mitered corners, or special finishing might take longer per door. We aim to provide a realistic timeline upfront, especially when working on projects in specific locations like Star or Kuna, factoring in travel and preparation times.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time depends on the number of doors and complexity; several standard doors can be cased in a day, but custom work takes longer.
